reasonGroups.reason: The words grade an approach, experience, feel, presentation or relationship. Routine messages, copying, courtesy or consistent title formats establish their functions rather than the particular elevated qualities claimed. In 227, enriched grades the billing routine; in 240, cohesive polish grades scheduling. Count each residual lexical base separately.

Bespoke or tailored claims individualized service or learning while the text supplies standard fields, preset choices, a shared template or an identical worksheet. Exclude the smallest complete tailoring claim as inflated evaluation, consistently with the parent controls; two residual vocabulary choices remain. This changes only V ownership and labels.

Richer context concerns each uploaded receipt, which is stored with an entered amount and a date and reopens with that amount. These specific contextual fields supply information about the image; holistic and multifaceted remain two ornaments. A reading of richer context as generic account polish remains plausible.

Holistic weekly page covers shared dinner planning with a per-person absence flag, retained household preferences and meal-linked ingredients. These linked household inputs establish whole-household scope, consistently with 007 and 043. Nuanced and enrich the choosing process remain two ornaments. A narrower reading that separates the weekly page from the household account would yield three.
